documents.text: Hybrid retrieval combines lexical and vector candidates with reciprocal rank fusion. 混合检索通过倒数排名融合两路候选。
Portable data roots keep originals under relative paths. 便携模式使用相对 dataRoot 路径保存原始文件。
Every answer citation points to a document chunk, content hash, and source location. 每条引用都能回到文档分块、内容哈希和来源位置。
The Python worker parses Markdown, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and HTML. Python worker 负责格式解析与结构化分块。
Remote model access requires per-library consent and agent token scopes. 远程模型访问必须经过逐库授权和令牌范围校验。
Query streaming emits retrieval, citation, answer_delta, and complete events. 查询流式接口发送检索、引用、回答增量和完成事件。
Durable jobs resume after restart and malformed jobs fail visibly. 持久化任务在重启后恢复，损坏任务会明确失败。
Backups need checksum validation and atomic restore through a staging directory. 备份恢复需要校验哈希并通过临时目录原子切换。
Skill mappings use explicit verify and repair operations without overwriting external files. Skill 映射通过显式校验和修复操作保护外部文件。
The desktop workbench shows libraries, documents, jobs, previews, and evidence. 桌面工作台展示知识库、文档、任务、预览和证据。
A release checklist records version numbers and changelog entries. 发布清单记录版本号和变更日志。
A healthy process is not by itself proof of a usable visible interface. 进程健康本身不能证明界面可用。
Index files should be copied only after their manifest is complete. 索引文件应在清单完整后复制。
A parser error should preserve the original object for inspection. 解析错误时应保留原始对象。
Local-first software keeps provider credentials out of the worker process. 本地优先软件不应把提供商密钥交给 worker。
A response timeout should include a request identifier in logs. 响应超时日志应包含请求标识。
Users can organize documents with folders and saved searches. 用户可以使用文件夹和固定搜索整理文档。
A portable package must not depend on a developer checkout path. 便携包不能依赖开发机目录。
